author: synced_reader plan, Task 6b follow-up (adversarial review fixes)
summary: Closes the two gaps an adversarial review found in Task 6b's restore endpoint (app/api/routers/projects_backups.py): (1) bundle_version was never validated at load despite ProjectBackupBundleModel carrying the field since Task 6a and the owner's versioned-contracts directive (flagged as a known gap in the Task 6b queue entry) -- now an unsupported or missing bundle_version returns 400 before any chapter processing begins; (2) the three zf.read('bundle.json') call sites in this file (list, metadata update, restore) had no size gate, unlike the existing audio/timing member reads -- now all three check file_size against a cap before reading.

changes.change: Added module constants _MAX_BUNDLE_JSON_BYTES (2 GB, same bound as the pre-existing _MAX_RESTORE_MEMBER_BYTES but named separately since it now guards bundle.json reads in three functions) and _SUPPORTED_BUNDLE_VERSION = 1. api_list_project_backups (~line 183): bundle.json is now getinfo()'d before read; oversized members are silently skipped (comment stays None), matching the function's existing best-effort try/except-pass pattern -- does not fail the whole listing. api_update_project_backup_metadata (~line 296): the bundle.json branch of the zin.infolist() rewrite loop now checks item.file_size and returns 400 (not a crash/500) before reading if it exceeds the cap. api_restore_project_backup (~lines 408-431): bundle.json is now getinfo()'d (catching KeyError as before for 'missing bundle.json'); a size-cap check returns 400 before the read; after parsing, bundle_data.get('bundle_version') != 1 returns 400 with message 'Unsupported backup bundle version' -- a MISSING bundle_version key is rejected the same as a wrong one (never defaulted to 1), so an old-format or hand-crafted bundle without the field cannot silently proceed. No other restore logic (arcname handling, path construction, chapter-scoping) was touched.

Added 4 new tests, all confirmed red (400 expected, 405/200 got) against pre-fix code via targeted git stash + restore, then green after implementation: test_restore_rejects_unsupported_bundle_version and test_restore_rejects_missing_bundle_version (hand-crafted bundle.json with bundle_version:2 / absent entirely -> 400, no chapter WAV touched); test_restore_rejects_oversized_bundle_json_without_crashing and test_list_and_update_backups_do_not_crash_on_oversized_bundle_json (monkeypatch zipfile.ZipFile.getinfo/infolist to report a fake 10GB bundle.json member -- avoids writing a real multi-GB fixture -- restore returns 400, list returns 200 with comment=None instead of reading it, update returns 400). Also added 'bundle_version': 1 to the two pre-existing hand-crafted security-test bundles (missing-arcname and arcname-escapes cases) so they keep exercising arcname/security behavior rather than incidentally tripping the new version gate -- those two tests are not about versioning and were adjusted to stay green under the additive check, all 6 pre-existing tests unaffected otherwise.

invariants: Restore's version check runs before any chapter_map iteration begins, so an unsupported/missing bundle_version rejects the whole request with zero chapter side effects (no writes, no DB updates) -- never a partial restore. bundle.json size gating never changes behavior for a bundle under the cap; the three call sites use the same 2GB bound as the pre-existing audio/timing member cap in this file, just as a separately named constant since it now guards three functions.
note: Directly resolves the flag_for_reviewer note in docs/code-map/queue/2026-07-17-synced-reader-task06b-backup-restore-endpoint.json ('No bundle_version compatibility gate was added...'). Review-driven fix, not new scope -- restore endpoint's other logic (arcname handling, path construction, chapter-scoping) intentionally left untouched.
